title: Lecture 2 — basic immutable programming
summary: Distinguish expressions, values, types, bindings, and effects in Pyking.
body: Use the [published slides](https://canvas.kth.se/courses/65461/files/10940350) with the [Pyking playground](https://pyking.org/playground/). Predict each result before running it. The guide below adds independent practice, separate from assessed ProgGame tasks.
